# PrintKit NYC: photo printer rental in New York City

PrintKit NYC (printkitnyc.com) rents one DNP DS40 dye-sublimation photo printer, run by Steve. Pickup and return are in person in Clinton Hill, Brooklyn; the address is shared after booking. There is no delivery and no on-site staff: renters run their own setup, with help by text and email during the rental.

## Who rents it
Photographers printing at events, photo booth operators, fashion week studios printing headshots and model boards, fundraisers handing out souvenir prints, and people running their own wedding or party photo booth.

## What's included
- DNP DS40 dye-sublimation photo printer
- Protective travel case, power and USB cables, print catcher tray
- Quick-start guide: https://printkitnyc.com/quickstart/

## Pricing
- Printer: $100 per day. Every calendar day the printer is out counts, including pickup and return days.
- Print media, one size per rental:
  - 4x6: $100 for 400 prints, in stock. 4x6 sheets can be cut into two 2x6 photo strips.
  - 6x8: $120 for 200 prints.
  - 5x7: $160 for 200 prints, special order with 7 days' notice.
- WCMPlus print server: $35 per day. Puts the printer on Wi-Fi with AirPrint, for iPad photo booths and multi-device setups.
- Refundable deposit: $200.
- NYC sales tax (8.875%) applies to rental and add-ons, not to the deposit.

## How to book
Request dates at https://printkitnyc.com/request. PrintKit NYC confirms availability within 1-2 business days, sends a rental agreement, then an itemized invoice. [Payment line from 3.4.]

## Support
Setup help and troubleshooting by text and email for the length of the rental. There's no backup unit, so renters should run a full test print at pickup.
